# V1 Reusable Knowledge Interchange Result

**Status:** PASS  
**Generated by:** GitHub Actions `V1 reusable knowledge interchange` workflow  
**Scope:** Executable validation evidence for Specification 004 candidate interchange contract

The JSON + JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 interchange contract passed on Python 3.12, 3.13, and 3.14 under Linux and Windows.

```text
KI-01  PASS  Draft 2020-12 schema self-validation
KI-02  PASS  heterogeneous ten-asset representative bundle
KI-03  PASS  unknown typed-property rejection
KI-04  PASS  malformed UUID/stable-key rejection
KI-05  PASS  malformed recursive rule-condition rejection
KI-06  PASS  deterministic dump/load/dump byte stability
KI-07  PASS  formatting-independent semantic digest
KI-08  PASS  unique human-readable relation endpoint resolution
KI-09  PASS  semantic duplicate-key rejection
KI-10  PASS  bundle-kind/governance import safety
```

The representative corpus includes Histogram, Missing Data, Temporal Validation, Random Forest, Prediction-Time Feature Eligibility, Class Imbalance, Prediction Moment, Bagging, ECDF, and Gradient-Boosted Trees. It remains BENCHMARK_FIXTURE/CANDIDATE material and is not accepted operational methodological knowledge.

The committed benchmark fixture is canonicalized through the same deterministic application serializer used by KI-06/KI-07.

This result validates representation/interchange structure and safety. It does not yet validate database import/export round-trip behavior, retrieval quality, an embedding model, reranking, or MethodologicalHorizon construction.
